entries.label: Morning brief
entries.text:
Today's session — Run/walk intervals: 3 × (10 min jog / 2 min walk):

Today you've got three rounds of ten-minute jogs with two-minute walks between them. That rhythm is the whole session — you don't need to be fast or perfect; just show up and let the intervals carry you. Lace up, step out, and take the first block as it comes — you've got this.
